audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[0-3].side all read 'Skill' (templated placeholder) while content win[0-3] and the packet levelChart all say Ashe wins levels 1-5, and phases[5-6].side read 'Skill' while win[5-6] and the packet say Sivir. The two layers disagreed on who wins levels 1-5 and first-item-plus.
audit.why: Ashe's Frost Shot (passive on-hit slow) and Volley (18/14.5/11/7.5/4s CD by rank) give her a real early poke-and-kite pattern Sivir has no early tool to answer, matching both the packet chart and the content whys already on the page; Sivir's crit/Ricochet spike from first item onward matches win[5-6]=Sivir.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side -> Ashe (rating 6/10), phases[5-6].side -> Sivir (rating unchanged), with matching why text; win[] left untouched since it already held the correct side.

audit.why: Power spikes are named concretely and now agree with the corrected chart: Ashe's early Frost Shot/Volley poke window, her level-6 Enchanted Crystal Arrow (100/80/60s CD) all-in, Sivir's first-item crit/Ricochet spike, and the late Spell Shield + On The Hunt teamfight spike. spikes[] already covers this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] (titled 'Spell-shield his engage tool') carried the tradeGood sentence about Q/W-bounce, unrelated to spell-shielding. dontsFull[2] (titled 'Chase kills off your tempo') carried the tradeBad sentence about E on chip damage, unrelated to chasing kills. Both flagged as copy-paste bleed, and both titles also misgendered Ashe as 'his'.
audit.why: Sivir's E (24/22.5/21/19.5/18s CD) blocks one targeted cast; Ashe's Volley reapplies its poke fast at high rank so one shield block doesn't stop the pattern — that belongs under 'Spell-shield her engage tool'. Chasing a kill under Ashe's tower costs Sivir's shove/tempo game plan — that belongs under 'Chase kills off your tempo'.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].t/.d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten and regendered; see edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ashe's Hawkshot (E, 5s CD, global range, reveals stealth) gives her map-wide vision pressure — being alive at low HP anywhere on the map is a risk, and this was never mentioned. Flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.why: Hawkshot's global scouting range and no-cooldown-to-speak-of uptime means Sivir cannot safely overextend or hide at low HP the way she could against a non-global-vision enemy.
audit.corrected: Added as new content field wants.foe[3] describing Hawkshot's global vision pressure.
